// A perfectly legal deck that the index cannot describe.
//
// The index is keyed by lowercased card name, and Scryfall prints a token
// called "Llanowar Elves" as well as the card. The token wins the key, so this
// list resolves to `Token Creature — Elf Druid`, mana value 0, `not_legal` in
// every format, `any_number` false. Read as facts about the card, that is two
// violations: an illegal card, and two copies of a singleton. Both are
// inventions about a card nobody has any data for.
//
// 100 cards, mono-green, one legendary creature commanding. Nothing here is
// against the rules and the run must say nothing at all.
1x Marwyn, the Nurturer [Commander{top}]

97x Forest [Land]

2x Llanowar Elves [Ramp - One Mana]
